problema.title: The invisible cost of "doing it all by hand"
problema.subtitleBold: Your day-to-day probably looks like this.
problema.subtitle: It seems normal, but it has a huge hidden cost in hours and credibility.
problema.card1Desc: A customer calls about a car you sold 3 weeks ago. You have to tell them it's gone, you look unprofessional, and you've wasted phone time on a useless lead.
problema.card2Desc: You keep track in a spreadsheet only you understand. You note the purchase price but forget to add the inspection or cleaning costs. Your margin calculation at month end is always just an estimate.
problema.card3Desc: You create the listing in the spreadsheet. Then you go to your website, upload the photos again by hand, copy and paste the text. Repetitive work with zero value.
problema.card4Desc: You buy a car, then pay for inspection, then cleaning, then a repair. Each expense ends up on a different receipt or mental note. When you sell, you have no idea how much you actually made.

comoFunciona.title: The simplest workflow in the industry.
comoFunciona.subtitle: From the moment you buy the car until you sell it, everything is recorded and connected. No spreadsheets, no duplicate work.
comoFunciona.step1Desc: Plate number, photos, purchase price and prep costs. You decide which data is public and which only you see. Everything tracked to the cent from the first moment.
comoFunciona.step2Desc: Mark the car as 'Available' and it appears automatically on your website. What you change in the panel updates your catalog instantly, without touching anything twice.
comoFunciona.step3Desc: Purchase, inspection, cleaning, transport. All expenses add up in real time, so you know how much you're making on each car before you sell it, not at month end.
comoFunciona.step4Desc: Register the sale and generate the contract in PDF if you need it. The car disappears from the website automatically and you decide what paperwork to do from here.

webConectada.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't.
webConectada.subtitle: The tools that solve the real day-to-day of managing a vehicle stock.
webConectada.card1Desc: What happens in StockDrive happens on your website instantly. Mark a car as sold and it disappears from your catalog automatically, without you having to go into your website or touch anything.
webConectada.card2Desc: Know your real gross margin on every deal, subtracting the purchase, inspection, cleaning and transport from the sale price. You know exactly how much you're making before you sell, not at month end.
webConectada.card3Desc: Register the sale with the buyer's details and automatically generate the official sales contract as a PDF. No Word templates, no filling anything in by hand.
webConectada.card4Desc: Find out how many visits each vehicle gets, how many leads it generates, and whether your customers prefer to message you on WhatsApp or call you. You know which cars are working and which need a push.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you start.
faq.q1: Do you publish on Coches.net, AutoScout24 or Wallapop?
faq.a1: Not for now. StockDrive manages and syncs your own website catalog, and we focus on making sure your direct channel is always perfect and your stock under control. Automatic publishing to listing portals is something we have on our radar for the future.
faq.q2: Is it a billing or accounting software?
faq.a2: For now it's a tool specifically for stock management, sales operations and website catalog. For accounting and tax filing, keep using your accountant's services. It's an area we'll keep expanding based on what the dealerships that trust us need.
faq.q3: Do I need to install an app on my phone?
faq.a3: There's no native app taking up space or requiring constant updates. StockDrive is a fully responsive web app (PWA). You can install it straight to your phone's home screen with one tap and it works exactly like an app.
faq.q4: How much does it cost and is there a minimum commitment?
faq.a4: Get in touch with us for a proposal tailored to the size of your stock. There's no mandatory commitment period: if StockDrive doesn't fit the way you work, you can cancel whenever you want.
faq.q5: What happens to my data if I stop using StockDrive?
faq.a5: Your data is yours. If you decide to stop using the platform, we'll help you export your information (stock, sales, contacts) in a format you can keep using wherever you go.
faq.q6: Do you offer support if I have a problem?
faq.a6: Yes, direct support via WhatsApp and email, with a response the same business day. No tickets lost in an automated system.
